subject: Reminder: Upcoming Family Gathering
body: Dear Family, Just a friendly reminder that our annual family gathering is scheduled for this Saturday at the Johnsons' residence. Please RSVP by Thursday if you haven't already done so. We are looking forward to spending quality time together and catching up on each other's lives. Feel free to bring any games or dishes you'd like to share. Looking forward to seeing all of you soon! Best regards, Sarah
